description: Download data from Garmin Connect into the local cache. Read tools already download missing data by themselves, so call this only when the user asks to sync/refresh or to pre-load a range, or when a tool returned meta.sync_hint (auto fetch turned off) and the user agreed; pass the hint's scope/from/to. Days already stored are skipped. Long ranges run in the background in 7-day chunks with pauses and a daily request cap to stay gentle with Garmin; this waits at most 20 s and reports progress (also in garmin://sync-status). Example: {"scope":"health","from":"2026-09-01","to":"2026-09-30"}.

force.description: Re-download days that are already stored

scope.description: all | activities | health (daily summary, sleep, HRV, weight) | training (status, readiness, VO2max) | reference (profile, gear, devices, activity types, workouts, calendar months of from..to, also in the future)

name: garmin_sync
title: Sync Garmin data
